tools.name: hgr_get_authenticated_user
tools.description: Reads the authenticated HGR user profile visible to the web app.

tools.name: hgr_list_channels
tools.description: Lists the user's connected stores/channels with channelOAuthId, store name, marketplace, country and connection status. Use channelOAuthId from this response for store-scoped endpoint tools.

tools.name: hgr_get_subscription_summary
tools.description: Reads the visible current subscription/quota summary. It never creates, changes or cancels subscriptions.

tools.name: hgr_get_active_listings
tools.description: Lists active listings for the selected visible store/channel. Use this for store-wide active listing/product questions, including most expensive products/listings, cheapest products/listings, stock checks, price ranking, source/supplier usage and other active listing aggregation. tools.name: hgr_get_pending_listings
tools.description: Lists pending listings for one visible store. First resolve the store with hgr_list_channels, then call this tool using channelOAuthId from the selected store. tools.name: hgr_get_terminated_listings
tools.description: Lists terminated listings for one visible store. First resolve the store with hgr_list_channels, then call this tool using channelOAuthId from the selected store. Supports fields, sortBy, sortDirection, limit and pagination declared by HGRApi. Terminated listings do not expose price or stock fields.

tools.name: hgr_get_listings
tools.description: Gets exact listings only by concrete HGR listing ids or visible marketplace primary ids. Do not use this tool to discover, scan, rank, filter or aggregate a store's listings. For bulk/global listing queries use active, pending or terminated listings instead. Do not use this tool to construct CSV, XM

tools.name: hgr_generate_limited_products_csv
tools.description: Generates the only product CSV allowed by MCP policy. It returns plain CSV text, not a downloadable file, and only includes the HGRWeb report columns: eBay item ID, sku, stock, cost price and selling price. Requires explicit productIds and confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAut

tools.name: hgr_update_listing
tools.description: Changes editable fields of one exact listing variation using HGRApi SaveProductChanges. Call only after the listing is exact and the user explicitly confirmed the action. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_force_refresh_listings
tools.description: Requests ForceRefresh for visible Product IDs. This confirms the request, not an immediate visible stock or price update. Requires confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_list_pending_now
tools.description: Publishes one pending listing immediately by its visible pending listing id. Requires confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_pause_pending_to_review
tools.description: Moves one pending listing to manual review by its visible pending listing id. Requires confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_remove_listing
tools.description: Removes or retires one listing by visible Product ID, or a pending listing by the visible pending listing id. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true after warning about consequences. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_terminate_listing
tools.description: Terminates one active listing by visible Product ID. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true after warning about consequences. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_relist_listing
tools.description: Relists one terminated listing by visible Product ID. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true after warning about consequences. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_get_listing_price_history
tools.description: Reads price history for one exact listing variation. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_get_listing_stock_history
tools.description: Reads stock history for one exact listing variation. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_search_orders
tools.description: Searches orders/order lines by visible order Reference and optional visible store. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_load_order_progress
tools.description: Reads progress for an order resolved from visible order Reference. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_load_order_addresses
tools.description: Loads available shipping addresses for an order resolved from visible order Reference. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_set_shipping_address
tools.description: Sets/corrects the shipping address for an order resolved from the visible order Reference. Requires confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_process_order_lines
tools.description: Starts normal processing for orders resolved from visible order Reference. Requires confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_force_process_order_lines
tools.description: Forces processing for orders resolved from visible order Reference. Requires confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_stop_order_lines
tools.description: Stops orders resolved from visible order Reference. Requires confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_mark_order_lines_fixed
tools.description: Marks orders resolved from visible order Reference as fixed/resolved. Requires confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_manually_dispatch_order_lines
tools.description: Marks orders resolved from visible order Reference as manually dispatched. Requires confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_mark_order_lines_as_purchased
tools.description: Marks exact order lines as purchased in HGR. The MCP resolves current WAPI status and uses FixedOrderLine only for CompletedAutoOrderPending. Requires confirmed=true after showing the full HGRWeb warning. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_generate_tracking_id
tools.description: Generates HGR tracking for exact order lines when WAPI allows it. The MCP checks current WAPI order status and current WAPI fee data before executing. Requires confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_set_manual_tracking_id
tools.description: Sets the manual tracking/reference state for one exact order line using WAPI ManualTrackingIdSet. Requires confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_get_sales
tools.description: Reads sales aggregates for the selected visible store using WAPI GetSales. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_get_sources
tools.description: Lists current sources/suppliers from WAPI for one visible store/channel, optionally filtered by visible countryCode. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_get_autoorder_fees
tools.description: Reads current auto-ordering fees from WAPI.

tools.name: hgr_get_autoordering_configuration
tools.description: Reads auto-ordering configuration from WAPI for one visible store/channel. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally. Secret fields are redacted before returning.

tools.name: hgr_save_autoordering_configuration
tools.description: Saves auto-ordering configuration with the exact WAPI request body for one visible store/channel. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally, confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true for supplier credential/configuration changes. Secret fields are redacted in the response.

tools.name: hgr_remove_autoordering_configuration
tools.description: Removes an auto-ordering configuration by autoOrderingAccountRef returned by hgr_get_autoordering_configuration for one visible store/channel. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally, confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true after warning about consequences.

tools.name: hgr_get_noapi_servers
tools.description: Reads No-API Server configuration/status. Passwords and secrets are redacted, and connection states are translated to human language.

tools.name: hgr_update_noapi_servers
tools.description: Updates No-API Server credentials/configuration with the exact WAPI credentials array for one visible store/channel. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally, confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true. Never returns passwords.

tools.name: hgr_get_noapi_solution_state
tools.description: Reads No-API Server verification/connection state for a visible store and translates it to human language. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_request_noapi_code
tools.description: Requests a No-API Server verification code for a visible store. Requires confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_send_noapi_code
tools.description: Sends a No-API Server verification code. Requires confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_send_noapi_answer
tools.description: Sends a No-API Server security answer. Requires confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_get_channel_configuration
tools.description: Reads store/channel configuration for one visible store. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_load_business_policies
tools.description: Loads marketplace business policies for one visible store. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_load_shipping_options
tools.description: Loads marketplace shipping options for one visible store. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_refresh_business_policies
tools.description: Refreshes marketplace business policies for one visible store. Requires confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_save_channel_setting
tools.description: Saves one channel setting using WAPI SaveOne. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true because channel settings can affect many listings. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_get_source_configuration
tools.description: Reads explicitly saved supplier settings for one visible store. This is settings data, not supplier availability or listing usage data. It must never be interpreted as an enabled, disabled or suspended supplier state. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_get_computed_source_configuration
tools.description: Reads effective supplier settings after store defaults and supplier overrides. This is settings data, not supplier availability or listing usage data. Boolean monitoring settings do not enable or disable a supplier. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_save_source_setting
tools.description: Saves one exact setting exposed by HGRWeb Supplier configuration. No supported setting enables, disables, suspends or re-enables a supplier. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true because source settings can affect many listings. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved int

tools.name: hgr_get_pricing_rules
tools.description: Reads pricing rules for one visible store. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_add_pricing_rule
tools.description: Adds a pricing rule for one visible store. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true because pricing rules can affect many listings. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_update_pricing_rule
tools.description: Updates a pricing rule for one visible store. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true because pricing rules can affect many listings. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_delete_pricing_rule
tools.description: Deletes/deactivates a pricing rule for one visible store. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true because pricing rules can affect many listings. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_get_price_warrior
tools.description: Reads Price Warrior dashboard/settings for one visible store. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_update_price_warrior_settings
tools.description: Updates Price Warrior settings for one visible store. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true because repricing can affect many listings. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_get_ai_agent_configuration
tools.description: Reads AI Agent configuration for one visible store. AI Agent is distinct from AI Publisher. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_get_ai_agent_dashboard
tools.description: Reads AI Agent dashboard and maturity metrics for one visible store. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_save_ai_agent_configuration
tools.description: Saves AI Agent configuration. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true; activation requires acceptedAiAgentTerms=true and disabling requires disableWarningConfirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_get_ai_publisher_filters
tools.description: Reads AI Publisher filters/automation configuration for one visible store. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_create_ai_publisher_agent
tools.description: Creates/activates the default AI Publisher automation for one visible store. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_change_ai_publisher_status
tools.description: Changes AI Publisher automation status for one visible store. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_update_ai_publisher_optimization
tools.description: Updates AI Publisher optimization columns. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_get_ai_publisher_history
tools.description: Reads AI Publisher history for one visible store. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_list_templates
tools.description: Lists listing templates for one visible store/channel. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

tools.name: hgr_make_default_template
tools.description: Marks a listing template as default for one visible store/channel. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally, confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true because templates can affect publishing flows.

tools.name: hgr_update_template
tools.description: Updates a listing template for one visible store/channel. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally, confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true because templates can affect publishing flows.

tools.name: hgr_get_virtual_assistants
tools.description: Lists Virtual Assistant / VA profiles. Prefer names in user-facing responses.

tools.name: hgr_add_virtual_assistant
tools.description: Adds a Virtual Assistant / VA profile. Requires confirmed=true.

tools.name: hgr_update_virtual_assistant
tools.description: Updates or deactivates a Virtual Assistant / VA profile. Requires confirmed=true.

tools.name: hgr_get_affiliate_dashboard
tools.description: Reads affiliate dashboard summary.

tools.name: hgr_get_affiliate_dashboard_monthly
tools.description: Reads affiliate monthly dashboard summary.

tools.name: hgr_get_affiliate_withdrawals
tools.description: Reads affiliate withdrawal history. Changing withdrawal method must be done in HGRWeb.

tools.name: hgr_get_support_ticket
tools.description: Reads one support ticket by its visible ticket id/reference.

tools.name: hgr_create_support_ticket
tools.description: Creates a text-only support ticket. File attachments are blocked by MCP policy. Requires confirmed=true.

tools.name: hgr_reply_support_ticket
tools.description: Replies to a support ticket with text only. File attachments are blocked by MCP policy. Requires confirmed=true.
